name: Elitegroup Computer Systems Co.,Ltd.
summary: Elitegroup Computer Systems Co.,Ltd. manufactures and supplies various computer products in Taiwan and internationally. It offers motherboards, such as Intel and AMD platform motherboards, and SoC solutions; tablet PCs; all in one, small form factor, LIVA, and PC on stick systems; IPC motherboards and systems; digital signage players and open pluggable specification products; and wireless access points. The company also provides IoT products, including gateways, solution ready platforms, Ai accelerator cards, virtual personal assistants, and smart logistics. In addition, it offers customized computer programming and hardware/software design services. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
